'''Extra Backpack Capacity''' is an [[Odyssey Engineering]] modification for pilot suits. It doubles the backpack limits for goods, assets, and data carried while on foot.

Despite the in-game description referring to consumables, the modification does not increase the capacity for grenades, medkits, energy cells, or e-breaches.<ref name="fandom-backpack">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Extra_Backpack_Capacity Elite Dangerous Wiki: Extra Backpack Capacity], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

== Effect ==

The modification applies these multipliers:

* '''Goods capacity:''' +100%
* '''Assets/component capacity:''' +100%
* '''Data capacity:''' +100%

Using the backpack values introduced in the 18.08 update, the resulting capacities are:

{| class="wikitable"
! Suit
! Goods
! Assets
! Data
|-
| Artemis
| 40
| 80
| 20
|-
| [[Dominator Suit|Dominator]]
| 20
| 40
| 20
|-
| Maverick
| 80
| 120
| 40
|}

Frontier's 18.08 release notes list the unmodified backpack values from which these totals are calculated.<ref name="frontier-1808">[https://elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-0-18-08 Frontier Developments: Type-8 Update Release Notes (18.08)], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

== Compatibility and Engineers ==

Extra Backpack Capacity can be installed on Artemis, Dominator, and Maverick suits with an open modification slot. It is provided by:

* [[Domino Green]]
* [[Wellington Beck]]
* [[Rosa Dayette]]

The Engineer must first be discovered, met, and unlocked. The suit and required materials must then be taken to that Engineer's workshop.

== Cost ==

The current modification recipe is:

* 5 Weapon Inventory
* 5 Chemical Inventory
* 5 Digital Designs
* 5 Epoxy Adhesive
* 3 Memory Chip
* 750,000 CR

Older guides may show larger requirements from before the 18.08 Odyssey Engineering rebalance.<ref name="inara-rosa">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/37/ INARA: Rosa Dayette], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

== When to use it ==

Extra Backpack Capacity is most useful on a Maverick suit used for settlement salvage, material collection, and missions that involve carrying several goods or data records. The Maverick's larger starting backpack also gives it the largest absolute increase.

The modification can still support specialised Artemis or Dominator loadouts, but it competes for a limited modification slot. Exploration and combat suits often gain more immediate value from battery, mobility, visibility, ammo, shield, or damage-resistance modifications.

A larger backpack reduces trips to a ship or SRV for inventory transfers. It does not change the Commander's total stored Odyssey-material capacity outside the active on-foot backpack.
